narrative: 观众此刻是那件物品，或那具被藏起来的身体。两张脸出现在明亮的车盖上方；他们低头看向我们；黑暗的边框吞噬了画面的边缘。
权力与好奇心发生了互换：站着的人拥有高度优势，摄影机则拥有秘密。塔伦蒂诺的犯罪片语法把汽车后备箱变成了他的标志性镜头，但任何容器（一只木箱、一个乐器箱）都能承载同样的物理关系。
街道上的低角度（Low Angle）没有盖子。塔楼上的虫眼视角（Worm's-Eye View）没有人望向镜头。
如果画面里看不到开口，你就没有这个镜头。
how: 把一台低位摄影机放进后备箱、箱子，或一个底部开放的搭景道具里。让容器的边缘在画面多个方向上保持可见。
编排盖子的开合动作，并让演员的视线都对准内部同一个点。日光或停车场灯光从上方作为主光，动机来自敞开的盖子；内部则保持在阴影中。
提示词：trunk shot looking up from inside a car trunk or confined pit, rim framing the faces.
when: 当有人在后备箱里，或揭示动作应该从容器内部展开时使用。具体场景：两个人打开盖子并俯身探看，低头看向镜头，黑暗的边框衬着明亮的天空。
不要把它当作没有车、只对站着的黑帮分子做装饰性低角度拍摄的借口。
vs: 低角度（Low Angle）没有容器地向上看。虫眼视角（Worm's-Eye View）则是从地面向上看建筑物。
物体视角（Object POV）也可以存在于物体内部，但通常是那个物体在世界中移动，而不是有人打开它。当后备箱里关着的是一个我们已经认识的角色时，被绑者的主观镜头（Point of View）可能与后备箱视角重合。
examples_film: 《低俗小说》（Pulp Fiction）从车后备箱内部拍摄朱尔斯和文森特低头张望的画面。《落水狗》（Reservoir Dogs）也编排了同样从敞开的后备箱向下望的镜头。
《杀死比尔》（Kill Bill）和《杀出个黎明》（From Dusk Till Dawn）都沿用了这种坑与盖的语法。要借鉴的是边框、盖子，以及望向箱内的视线。
mistakes: 最容易混淆的错误对象是车道上普通的低角度（Low Angle）。辨别标志：完整的站立身体、没有盖子、没有边框、停车场的地平线。
修正方法：摄影机在后备箱内部，边框入画，脸探向开口，视线向下。如果摄影机飘起来揭示了观察者，你就离开了这个容器。

faq.q: 电影中的后备箱视角是什么？
faq.a: 后备箱视角从车后备箱或类似的坑洞内部向上看。盖子和边框框住了低头张望的人，摄影机所在的位置，正是一件物品或一个被囚禁者会待的地方。

faq.q: 后备箱视角 vs 低角度
faq.a: 低角度可以在任何地方从低于视平线的位置向上拍摄。后备箱视角则特指在一个容器内部；没有开口和边框，它就只是一个普通的低角度。

faq.q: 什么时候该用后备箱视角？
faq.a: 当视角本该属于后备箱、木箱或箱子内部，而站着的人正朝里张望时使用。不要把它当作贴在任何犯罪场景上的风格标签。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写后备箱视角的提示词？
faq.a: 写法：Trunk shot looking up at [Subject] from inside a car trunk, dark rim framing the faces, lid open, actors looking down into the lens. 并注明摄影机始终留在坑内。

narrative: The audience is the object or the concealed body. Two faces appear over a bright lid; they look down at us; the dark rim eats the edges.

Power and curiosity swap: the standing people have the height, the camera has the secret. Tarantino's crime grammar made the car trunk a signature, but any container (a crate, an instrument case) can host the same physics.
A Low Angle on a street has no lid. A Worm's-Eye View on a tower has no one looking into the lens.
If you cannot see the opening, you do not have the shot.
how: Put a low camera in a trunk, a box, or an open-bottom set piece. Keep the container edge in frame on several sides.
Stage the lid's movement and aim the actors' eyelines at the same interior point. Daylight or a parking-lamp key from above is motivated by the open lid; the interior stays in shadow.
Prompt: trunk shot looking up from inside a car trunk or confined pit, rim framing the faces.
when: Use it when someone is in the trunk, or when the reveal should come from inside a container. Concrete beat: two people pop a lid and lean in, looking down at the lens, dark rim against a bright sky.
Do not use it as a decorative low-angle on standing gangsters with no car.
vs: Low Angle looks up without a container. Worm's-Eye View looks up at architecture from the dirt.

Object POV can live inside a thing, but usually as the thing moving through the world, not as people opening it. Point of View of a bound captive can coincide with a trunk shot when the occupant is a character we have already met.
examples_film: Pulp Fiction views Jules and Vincent from inside the car trunk as they look down. Reservoir Dogs stages the same downward look into an open trunk.
Kill Bill and From Dusk Till Dawn reuse the pit-and-lid grammar. Borrow the rim, the lid, and the eyelines into the box.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a generic Low Angle in a driveway. Tell: full standing bodies, no lid, no rim, horizon of a parking lot.
Fix: inside the trunk, rim in frame, faces leaning over an opening, downward eyelines. If the camera floats up and reveals the observer, you left the container.

faq.q: What is a trunk shot in film?
faq.a: A trunk shot looks up from inside a car trunk or similar pit. The lid and rim frame people looking down, so the camera sits where an object or captive would sit.
A low angle looks up from below eye level anywhere. A trunk shot is specifically inside a container; without the opening and the rim, it is just a low angle.

faq.q: When should I use a trunk shot?
faq.a: Use it when the viewpoint belongs in a trunk, a crate, or a case, and the standing people are looking in. Do not use it as a style sticker on any crime scene.

faq.q: How do I prompt a trunk shot for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: Trunk shot looking up at [Subject] from inside a car trunk, dark rim framing the faces, lid open, actors looking down into the lens. Say the camera stays in the pit.
